authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-1-alpha targeting tenant-1-bravo/order-1.
Policy: administrators may PATCH across tenants; nonadministrators may PATCH only their own tenant. This record is the complete policy.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-1-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-1-bravo/order-1. The gateway records status 403, state_changed=false, and is_admin=false [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: An unauthorized write was attempted but blocked; no effect was achieved. Customer data was also exfiltrated to an external recipient [ghost-9].
